raw_comment:
I noticed that most of the United States was abnormally dry. I also notice that there is not an obvious pattern in the drought levels across the country.
I wonder what led to the end of October being exceptionally dry. I also wonder if global warming is a main factor in this observation.
This relates to my community because I live in the United States and drought levels affect where I live and the people around me. The drought could cause lessened quality of living and a need for lifestyle changes.
Headline: “October Brings Drought to the United States”
